question: The total number of Ministers, including the Prime Minister, in the Council of Ministers shall not exceed ______ percent of the total number of members of the House of the People.
solution:
The correct answer is __**fifteen**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The provision regarding the **number of Ministers** in the** Council of Ministers **is mentioned in **Article 75(1)** of the Constitution of India.
 
• The Council of Ministers shall be collectively responsible to the House of the People (Lok Sabha).
 
• Hence, the number of Ministers hould not be so large as to make the House ineffective in its role of controlling the executive.
 
• Council of Ministers: It is the group of Ministers who are collectively responsible for the governance of the country. The Ministers are appointed by the President on the advice of the Prime Minister.
 
• Prime Minister: The Prime Minister is the head of the Council of Ministers. He/she is appointed by the President and holds the office during the pleasure of the President.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The primary executive arm of the Indian government,** the Union Council of Ministers** serves as the highest decision-making body within the executive branch.
 
• The leaders of all executive government ministries are present, with the prime minister serving as its chair.
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi is currently in charge of the council, which has 29 members total, including the prime minister.
 
• The Indian Parliament has jurisdiction over the council.
